out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. HAND SINK AT THE SERVICE LINE WAS USED TO DUMP ICE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM EDUCATED THE FOOD EMPLOYEES.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the SANITIZER BUCKET with a concentration of LESS THAN 200ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. PLEASE MANUALLY ADJUST THE CONCENTRATION OF SANITIZER TO 200PPM TO 400PPM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: THE CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER FOR QUATERNARY AMMONIA AT 3- COMPARTMENT SINK IS IN NEED OF SERVICE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM PLACED A WORK ORDER.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The permit holder has removed the water heater previously approved by the Health Department. The new water heater (Make: Navien, Model: NPE-240A2, BTU input 199,900) does not have the capacity to meet the hourly peak hot water demands of the food establishment. The current peak hot water demand is 8.3GPM of 120F water at a 80F rise. 40.6% DEFICIENCY IS OBSERVED.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of 60gph of 140F water at a 100F rise, and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department.
